submittedParameters.prompt:
One NEW independently AI-redrawn game animation sprite, frame N/1. EDIT TARGET first reference: preserve exact direction, head and body size, camera distance, root center and costume. STRICT REAR view initial RIGHT heel strike, one moment before target's compression. Preserve target's corrected arms: bell SCREEN LEFT elbow forward into depth beside head, cards SCREEN RIGHT elbow back toward viewer. Straighten supporting SCREEN RIGHT knee slightly (not locked) and raise pelvis15px by joint posture, right heel touches same ground x/y. SCREEN LEFT knee folds back toward viewer. Right shoe full thin outsole edge, no oversized visible supporting underside. Real right contact, not running on air.
Full original red gold fire boy: brown ponytail ruby crown, tied rear coat, black trousers, red gold shoes. LEFT HAND one brass bell; RIGHT HAND fan of FIVE red talismans. Same original soft painted Q-dao style. Portrait and style references are identity/material only, never their camera or screen handedness. Square native1024+ true alpha, full body margins; no autozoom, no mirror, no copied parts or interpolation. No floor, shadow, effects, text or particles.
